name: MPWG RALA
author: James
description: Phase 3 piecewise RALA ramp (2026-09-rala-p3b). Linear RGBA between James's RadarScope calibration anchors and inspector taps, not a generic smooth gradient and not a saturation boost. Yellow holds through the high 30s and low 40s; light orange around 44; orange (not red) through the upper 40s; solid red from about 50.6; magenta from 56.4 and purple by 61.2. Weak greens stay crisp but partial-alpha. Bookends at -32 (faintest valid wisp) and 78 (pale pink). No cyan/aqua stop. Legend ticks are these stops (not -32/5/15/29/36/55/75+). No-echo and missing stay alpha 0 via the category mask. Valid very-low dBZ stays visible. display_min_dbz=-32. Composite keeps mpwg-clean-2026-09.
